notes: Summary: Procurement stalled and ultimately closed-lost. Zephyrus was evaluating Redwood Private for a research cluster (doc search + summarization), required VPC/on-prem and strict data residency. Security review escalated to legal and infosec in Jan 2026; primary failure was inability/unwillingness to provide SOC2 Type II evidence and ISO27001 scope artifacts. Client asserted audit artifacts are restricted by their auditor NDA and would not permit distribution even under our standard evidence-exchange NDA. Infra raised an ISO scope gap: their ISO27001 cert excludes several third-party cloud controls (backups, vendor mgmt), which we flagged as unacceptable for our private offering.
